# apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code (Resource)

Defines an offer code for an in-app purchase: a discounted price for eligible customers. Customers redeem it with custom codes or one-time-use codes. Only `active` changes in place; other changes create a new offer code. App Store Connect can't delete an offer code, so destroying the resource deactivates it. Import it with `<in_app_purchase_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code" "half" {
  in_app_purchase_id     = apple_in_app_purchase.coins.id
  name                   = "Half price"
  customer_eligibilities = ["NON_SPENDER"]
  prices = [
    { territory = "USA", price_point_id = data.apple_in_app_purchase_price_points.usd.price_points[0].id },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_eligibilities` (Set of String) Customers who can redeem the code: `NON_SPENDER`, `ACTIVE_SPENDER`, `CHURNED_SPENDER`.
- `in_app_purchase_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase, e.g. `apple_in_app_purchase.example.id`.
- `name` (String) Reference name of the offer code.
- `prices` (Attributes Set) Price of the offer in each territory where it's redeemable; see `data.apple_in_app_purchase_price_points`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prices))

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the offer code can be redeemed. Deactivating is permanent, so setting it back to `true` creates a new offer code. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer code.

<a id="nestedatt--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prices`

Required:

- `price_point_id` (String) Price point of the offer in the territory; see `data.apple_subscription_price_points`.
- `territory` (String) Territory, e.g. `USA`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code.half
  identity = {
    in_app_purchase_id = "6446452615"
    id                 = "9876543210"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer code.
- `in_app_purchase_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the in-app purchase.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_in_app_purchase_offer_code.half 6446452615/9876543210
```
